findings.title: Rowboat through 0.9.1 custom MCP server SSRF
findings.evidence_classification: direct CVE JSON plus NVD publication record with public issue and code references
findings.factual_summary: Rowboat through 0.9.1 does not sufficiently validate custom MCP server and webhook URLs. Authenticated users can configure arbitrary destinations, allowing SSRF against internal services and cloud metadata endpoints and enabling internal network-topology enumeration.
findings.affected_boundary_or_version: rowboatlabs/rowboat through 0.9.1; custom MCP server and webhook URL handling
findings.security_delta: New CVE publication for an MCP configuration path that turns delegated agent connectivity into internal network reachability.
findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_security: Agent platforms that let users attach MCP servers or webhooks need URL, host, IP-range, and metadata-service controls because an apparently delegated integration can become an SSRF path from the agent runtime.

findings.title: cli-mcp-server 0.2.5 command allowlist bypass
findings.evidence_classification: direct CVE JSON plus NVD publication record with public issue, product, code, and third-party advisory references
findings.factual_summary: cli-mcp-server 0.2.5 allows a command allowlist bypass in _validate_command_with_operators when ALLOW_SHELL_OPERATORS is enabled. Shell substitution syntax can execute commands outside ALLOWED_COMMANDS.
findings.affected_boundary_or_version: MladenSU cli-mcp-server 0.2.5; ALLOW_SHELL_OPERATORS-enabled command validation path
findings.security_delta: New CVE publication for an MCP command-execution server where allowlist enforcement fails when shell operators are allowed.
findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_security: MCP servers that broker shell access for agents need parser-equivalent command policy, because shell substitution can turn a seemingly constrained tool call into arbitrary command execution.

upstream_routing.ai_wiki: cli-mcp-server as an MCP server catalog item is upstream-owned if durable product coverage is needed.
upstream_routing.ai_dev_wiki: General shell-tool governance and command approval practices route to ai-dev-wiki when framed as AI-assisted development workflow.
upstream_routing.ai_security_wiki_local_scope: Keep the shell-substitution bypass, affected version, allowlist failure mode, and MCP tool-execution security implication here.
